FMT_DIC.ROM (md5): 34847786d7de94b5d1133c956ab1d75d|These are the FM Towns Model 1/2 ROMs; file names are accepted in any case (fmt_sys.rom...).|Place the ROMs in system/geartowns/, in a subfolder such as system/geartowns/fmtowns/, or as the MAME set system/geartowns/fmtowns.zip; system/ is searched the same way as a fallback.|Each set is recognized by its system ROM; modified or unknown ROMs also load, with a warning.|FMT_F20.ROM is optional; a blank ROM is used if it is missing.|The FM Towns II UX needs its own set (MAME fmtownsux), in system/geartowns/fmtownsux/ or as system/geartowns/fmtownsux.zip; the 1F/2F, 10F/20F, CX and UG run on it too.|The FM Towns II HR needs its own set (MAME fmtownshr), in system/geartowns/fmtownshr/ or as system/geartowns/fmtownshr.zip. The FM Towns II ME runs on it too.|The FM Towns Marty needs its own set (MAME fmtmarty: mrom.m36 and mrom.m37, or the Marty 2 files with MAR_EX0-3.ROM), in system/geartowns/fmtmarty/ or as system/geartowns/fmtmarty.zip.|Free FM Towns Project replacement ROMs are also supported.[CR][CR]BIOS files are required for this core to function correctly
